reference_sql:
SELECT 'Voltmarkt' AS source, list_price_eur AS price_eur
FROM price_history
WHERE product_id = 3
  AND valid_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
UNION ALL
SELECT competitor, price_eur
FROM competitor_prices
WHERE product_id = 3
  AND observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
alternatives: SELECT competitor AS source, price_eur FROM competitor_prices WHERE product_id = 3 AND year(observed_ts) = 2025 UNION ALL SELECT 'Voltmarkt', list_price_eur FROM price_history WHERE product_id = 3 AND year(valid_from) = 2025

WITH price_points AS (SELECT product_id, 'Voltmarkt' AS source, list_price_eur AS price_eur, CAST(valid_from AS TIMESTAMP) AS seen_ts FROM price_history UNION ALL SELECT product_id, competitor, price_eur, observed_ts FROM competitor_prices) SELECT source, price_eur FROM price_points WHERE product_id = 3 AND seen_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND seen_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
